column1: BAS measures the percentage of checkable factual claims that were confirmed through independent verification.
CDI measures how much of the predefined attribute space the model covered without being explicitly prompted for each individual topic.
**44 of 72 possible brand-category pairs were covered.**
The model was highly accurate about the information it volunteered.
The larger gap was **what it did not volunteer**.
High factual accuracy does not necessarily mean a deep representation of a brand.
